svg.text: Implementation notes
EqualExpenseSplit calculates and compares shares, but the mismatch body only contains a comment; it does not throw.
UnequalExpenseSplit and PercentageExpenseSplit validators are empty. Split stores amountOwe; it has no percentage field.
All fields are package-private. Only Demo.main and SplitFactory.getSplitObject are static. Implicit Java constructors are omitted.
Multiplicity 1 reflects constructor initialization; 0..1 reflects externally supplied nullable references. No strict composition is asserted.
